Method of Attack: Information-stealing Trojan that downloads required libraries and installs two Qulab trojans: one miner and one clipboard hijacker (clipper). The clipper substitutes copied cryptocurrency addresses with attacker-controlled addresses to steal cryptocurrency.
Attack Vector: Fake Cryptohopper site distributing Setup.exe executable that installs Vidar Trojan and subsequently downloads QuLab trojans.
Indicators of Compromise: Setup.exe executable using CryptoHopper logo as icon
Scheduled tasks launching clipper and miner executables every minute
Cryptocurrency addresses substituted by clipper (e.g., Bitcoin 1FFRitFm5rP5oY5aeTeDikpQiWRz278L45)
